points.point: What 'Failed after 3 retries (Unknown error reason)' means
points.sentence: Unknown error reason is a fallback for an unmapped failure reason, not proof of an outage or credit problem.

points.point: Whether to turn off retries and resubmit repeatedly
points.sentence: Check the destination before another submission, then send support the full error and reference IDs.

verdict.reason: This entry covers the exact TikTok error and says to check the destination before submitting again instead of resubmitting right away.
